mainText: Hello, Verona! At 6 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we have clear skies at Badger Prairie County Park and a temperature of 63 degrees, but please note the moderate air quality index of 52.

The city is hiring an engineering technician to oversee municipal construction projects, and don't forget that you can also apply for a 30 dollar rebate through the city's rain barrel program for your home.
There is plenty to do with live music taking place today at Bailey's Run Vineyard and Wisconsin Brewing Company, followed by the Dane County Farmer's Market tomorrow at the Capitol Square.
During the week, the Verona Police Department responded to several calls, including an incident on Friday, August 15, where a woman was arrested for her first O W I offence.
The Culver's flavor of the day is the delightful Peanut Butter Fudge Brownie. The store is currently closed but will open its doors at 10 AM, so get ready to stop by for a treat.
